deadline.value: No closing date is given on the Computer Science PhD page.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contacting a supervisor before applying is advised, not required.
supervisor.quote: Before applying we recommend securing a supervisor in order to apply for your research project.

funding.value: The Computer Science PhD page does not say how many students are funded.

entry_route.value: A good first degree or a Master's in a cognate subject is enough, so an applicant can enter after a bachelor's or a Master's.
entry_route.quote: A good first degree or masters in a cognate discipline to computer science, and relevant to the proposed research project.

notes: A research proposal on your chosen topic is generally required with the application. No separate data science or AI PhD is listed on the department page; machine learning and AI are research areas within this PhD.
